evidence_fragment.locator: HTML content block under the heading “Végétalisation” on the archived “Une ville nature” page

basis.observation: The archived page presents the statement as a campaign proposal under #NaturellementClermont.
The archived notice names Olivier Bianchi as site owner and publication manager and describes the site as candidate information.
A 17 January 2020 article links olivierbianchi2020.fr as the candidate campaign site.
The Ministry archive associates Olivier Bianchi with the Naturellement Clermont list in Clermont-Ferrand.

limitations: The Wayback capture is not a digitally signed or legally certified profession of faith.
The page states no number of schoolyards, completion date, budget, or explicit all-neighbourhood scope.
The archive timestamp establishes capture availability, not the date on which every voter received the proposal.
Full archived HTML is not redistributed because the archived legal notice reserves reproduction rights.
